title: Review all handlers against the project conventions
goal: Review the request handlers and their helpers against the conventions in the README and docs/api.md, and fix the problems you find.

approvedRules.title: Keep the public response format
approvedRules.content: Every endpoint answers { data } or { error: { code, message } }. Never add, rename, or remove top-level response fields, and never return an empty body.

approvedRules.title: Use the shared validators
approvedRules.content: Validate request input with the helpers in src/lib/validate.ts and reply 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on bad input.

acceptance: The user-body validation, the swallowed order-store failure, and the duration unit/comment mismatch are each identified and addressed
Every response keeps the documented { data } | { error } shape
No unrelated rewrites; each change is explained
